integrity: The proof is analytic and uses exact Lie-derivative identities. No numerical experiment is used to infer an infinite-time conclusion.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies compactly supported invariant probability measures, not all trajectories or all compact invariant sets. It does not distinguish long transients from unbounded numerical trajectories. Later pages of the primary article were not available in the same full-text access attempt, although the model and all parameter regimes used in the claim were directly inspected.
title: Stationary moment obstruction in a five-dimensional quartic cross-product flow
